newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen down on continued foreign sales.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen down on continued foreign sales.

text.p: Thai stocks were expected to continue falling on Thursday as foreign investors were expected to further sell, brokers said.
The SET index slipped 6.90 points by the close on Wednesday to 949.44. Total turnover was 5.7 billion baht.
"Local mutual funds are expected to wait until selling pressure by foreigners slowed down," said Chetta Meemangkang of Prime Finance and Securities.
Foreigners have been selling heavily since last week on fears that Thai banks' profit growth in 1996 would be lower than the 15.6 percent posted in 1995.
